verdict.rationale: The plan docs describe a destroy mode that builds a plan to destroy all remote objects that currently exist, leaving an empty OpenTofu state. That plan can be saved with -out and executed through `tofu apply`, which covers tearing down an entire environment. `tofu test` also destroys the resources it creates, showing teardown is part of the core workflow. Missing for 10: dedicated `tofu destroy` command documentation, details on dependency-ordered teardown and error handling, and independent or hands-on confirmation that teardowns complete cleanly.
